news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.28 (up from ₹9.73 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹41.7b (up 19% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.61b (up 11% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.9% (down from 4.1% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 3.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Metals and Mining industry in India.
